scripts.build: npm run build -w @cns/backend-protocol && npm run build -w backend_service && npm run build -w frontend/dev-simulator && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cns/backend-protocol && npm run typecheck -w backend_service && npm run typecheck -w frontend/dev-simulator && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cns/backend-protocol && npm run test -w backend_service && npm run test -w frontend/dev-simulator && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @cns/backend-protocol && npm run dev -w backend_service
scripts.dev:simulator: npm run build -w @cns/backend-protocol && npm run dev -w frontend/dev-simulator
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @cns/backend-protocol && concurrently -n simulator,frontend -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w frontend/dev-simulator" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:integration: npm run build -w @cns/backend-protocol && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev -w backend_service" "npm run dev:backend -w frontend"
